text: Beauty gained the most reviews since yesterday by a wide margin, led by big brands and body-care combos, while health and kids' wear came next. For a beginner, home & kitchen and jewellery still look best: a ₹91 fridge cover was the day's standout unbranded mover, and jewellery sets stay light, cheap and low on complaints.

headline: Women's ethnic: everyday kurtis still lead, bandhani sarees are moving
text: Kurtis gained the most reviews since yesterday, with a ₹295 kurta and a ₹201 kurti on top. Among sarees, shimmer, bandhani and lehariya designs are climbing ahead of Diwali and Chhath, and several new bandhani listings appeared today. The typical price is about ₹291 and about 9% of reviews are 1-star. Sellers are mostly in Gujarat and Rajasthan, so competition on price is strong. Free-size sarees are an easier start than sized kurtis.

headline: Women's western: simple shirts and tank tops keep selling, jackets are rising
text: A ₹194 women's shirt gained the most reviews since yesterday, followed by a ₹294 girls' jacket, an early winter signal. Tank tops at about ₹165 are steady sellers, and combo packs do well. The typical price is about ₹290, with about 7% 1-star reviews, which is lower than most clothing. Delhi and Gujarat sellers lead. Sizes still mean returns, so start with a small range.

headline: Men's clothing: slowest daily growth, and the most complaints
text: This category gained the fewest new reviews since yesterday, mostly on shirts priced ₹248 to ₹392. New hoodie and winter sweatshirt listings keep appearing, so the season is starting, but they have not built up strong sales yet. It has the highest 1-star share of any category at about 12%, which points to quality complaints and returns. The typical price is about ₹326. It is not a good first category unless you have a reliable supplier.

headline: Kids & toys: cheap sets and winter socks are moving fast
text: Kids gained the third-most new reviews since yesterday. A ₹136 top-and-bottom set leads, and winter socks and sweaters are climbing with the weather. The typical price is low at about ₹182, so margins are thin, and about 9.5% of reviews are 1-star, mostly on clothing. Toys avoid size returns, which makes them the easier way in. Gujarat and Delhi sellers lead.

headline: Home & kitchen: a ₹91 fridge cover was today's standout
text: A ₹91 fridge cover gained the most reviews since yesterday, followed by sticky wall hooks, evil-eye wall hangings and agarbatti, all cheap and useful. Cotton diya wicks are back among today's new listings just before Diwali on 8 November, but it is very late to start festive stock now. The typical price is about ₹155 and about 8% of reviews are 1-star. These items are light and have no sizes, which suits a beginner. Gujarat and Haryana sellers lead.

headline: Beauty: most daily growth by far, but brands own it
text: Beauty gained far more reviews since yesterday than any other category, led by cocoa butter body lotion combos, a Bombay Shaving Company razor and Mamaearth face wash. Most top sellers are brands, and reselling them needs the brand's authorisation, while making your own cosmetics needs a licence. Unbranded items such as silicone back scrubbers are the realistic entry. The typical price is about ₹175, with about 8% 1-star reviews.

headline: Jewellery: steady, light and ahead of wedding season
text: Rhodium and American-diamond sets gained the most reviews since yesterday, along with bracelets and ring combos, though daily growth is modest compared with beauty and kids. New bridal-style listings such as bangle sets and 1-gram gold sets appeared today, which fits the wedding season starting later this month. The typical price is about ₹166, and about 7% of reviews are 1-star. Items are very light with no sizes, so shipping and returns stay easy. Gujarat and Maharashtra sellers lead.

headline: Bags & footwear: wallets and handbags move steadily
text: A ₹114 men's wallet gained the most reviews since yesterday, with women's flip-flops, backpacks and shoulder bags close behind. Handbags remain the largest type overall. The typical price is about ₹191 with about 7% 1-star reviews. Bags and wallets have no sizes, while footwear does, so start with bags. Delhi sellers lead.

headline: Electronics: phone holders are growing, earbuds draw complaints
text: Phone holders and stands took most of the top growth spots since yesterday, along with a wooden Bluetooth speaker. Many earbud listings are still being added, but this category has about 11% 1-star reviews, and earbuds have drawn some of the highest complaint rates here. The typical price is about ₹341. If you try this category, start with holders and stands, not earbuds. Delhi and Gujarat sellers lead.

headline: Health & fitness: branded basics lead, ear-lobe patches keep selling
text: Health gained the second-most new reviews since yesterday, led by Dabur toothpaste and Stayfree and Everteen pads, which a beginner can't easily resell. Ear-lobe support patches are the unbranded item that keeps selling. New football and cricket listings show winter sports demand. It has the lowest 1-star share of any category at about 6%, and the typical price is about ₹237.

Fridge covers, which were today's standout home mover at about ₹91.
Sticky wall hooks and evil-eye wall hangings, which sell all year.
Jewellery sets and bangle sets, for the wedding season starting later this month.
Men's wallets and women's handbags, with no sizes to worry about.
Ear-lobe support patches, a low-priced unbranded health seller.
Phone holders and stands, with fewer complaints than earbuds.
Avoid for now: earbuds and men's shirts (more complaints), sized clothing (returns), branded beauty and pads (need authorisation), and Diwali-only stock (too late to start).
